'''Bay thirty-six''' was a landing bay within the [[Whitestone City spaceport]] in [[Whitestone City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>  a [[stormtrooper station]] was located nearby, between the bay and [[Bay thirty-five|thirty-five]].<ref name="COO" />
